pkgmetadata.longdescription: openspec-superpowers-opencode (oso) is a pure Node.js CLI that bridges Superpowers + OpenSpec workflows into OpenCode with enforced git-worktree isolation. It provides one-command init, per-change isolated worktrees, a 13-command OPSX lifecycle, and SHA-256-verified skill deployment. Zero runtime npm dependencies; it shells out to the openspec CLI, opencode, and git at runtime.
